properties.name: UAS Facility Map ceiling: 0 ft AGL
properties.remark: FAA UAS Facility Map: every grid cell in this zone has a ceiling of 0 ft AGL — no altitude is pre-approved here. The map authorizes nothing on its own; operators must still apply.
properties.conditions: FAA authorization is required for every flight in this controlled airspace (14 CFR 107.41) — not only above the mapped ceiling. The mapped ceiling here is 0 ft AGL: there is no band below it, so no near real-time LAANC approval is available. Apply through a "further coordination request" (Part 107 pilots only, up to 90 days ahead) or FAADroneZone.
